name: Clustered Grid Cell (CGC) Data Structure
definition: A memory-efficient data structure for storing active grid cells of a volume for isosurface rendering. It stores grid positions and corner scalar values in a clustered hierarchy, eliminating the need for the original volume data during rendering.
summary: The Clustered Grid Cell data structure is a memory-efficient isosurface rendering format that stores active cells as primitives with corner scalars, eliminating GPU volume textures and reducing memory usage by approximately 37 percent compared to mesh-based methods.
